questions.scenario: You are traveling in a crowded local train or city bus. What do you do?

options.text: I figure out the fastest route by changing lines perfectly to save time.
I try to predict exactly how many people will get off at the next station.
I look at the metro map and admire how nicely the colored lines are drawn.
I wonder how much daily revenue the transport department is making from tickets.

questions.scenario: During the IPL Cricket season, what is your favorite thing to do?

options.text: I keep track of all the points tables, net run rates, and team standings daily.
I predict which team will win based on the pitch report and past records.
I love looking at the animated graphs and spider-webs they show on TV for player stats.
I create my Dream11 team strategically to win cash prizes.

questions.scenario: Mummy asks you to organize the chaotic kitchen grocery cabinet.

options.text: I empty everything and build a new, highly efficient system to store dal and rice.
I sort items by expiry date so we consume the oldest ones first logically.
I put everything in matching glass jars and label them beautifully.
I make a list of missing items and calculate the budget for the next supermarket run.

questions.scenario: You get your final school report card in your hands.

options.text: I add up the marks manually to check if the teacher made a calculation mistake.
I compare my marks with previous terms to see if my performance trend is going up.
I look at the colorful bar chart or grade wheel printed on the back of the card.
I use my good grades to confidently negotiate with Papa for a new gadget.

questions.scenario: You are scrolling through an e-commerce app like Amazon or Myntra.

options.text: I filter by price, rating, and brand to narrow down exactly what I want instantly.
I read all the 1-star reviews to find the hidden flaws of the product.
I ignore the text and just look at the high-quality product images and videos.
I look for 'combo offers' or credit card discounts to save maximum money.

questions.scenario: You are at a massively crowded Indian wedding.

options.text: I figure out the exact physical path to reach the food stalls bypassing the crowd.
I try to logically guess how much the whole wedding cost by looking at the decor.
I focus on the colorful outfits, the aesthetic lighting, and the stage setup.
I coordinate with my cousins to secure the best VIP seats before everyone else.

questions.scenario: You are playing a strategy board game (like Chess or Ludo).

options.text: I strictly follow the rules and make sure nobody cheats the system.
I calculate my opponent's next 3 moves in my head before I play my turn.
I just enjoy the design of the board and the physical feel of the pieces.
I form secret alliances with other players to dominate the game.

questions.scenario: You are assigned to do a school project on 'Global Warming'.

options.text: I collect raw data from 10 different websites and combine it into one clean folder.
I analyze the data to find out exactly which country is causing the most pollution.
I draw a colorful pie chart and a beautiful world map on a chart paper.
I present the topic to the class confidently like a professional TED talk speaker.

questions.scenario: How do you manage your pocket money?

options.text: I keep all my cash safely sorted by notes in a specific wallet compartment.
I mentally calculate how many days the money will last at my current spending rate.
I write down my daily expenses in a beautiful, color-coded diary.
I save up to buy something big, or lend it to a friend for a small 'interest' favor.

questions.scenario: Your computer starts hanging and running very slow.

options.text: I open Task Manager and strictly force-close the heavy background apps.
I run an antivirus scan to figure out the exact root cause of the lag.
I use the waiting time to clean up my messy desktop icons into neat folders.
I tell my parents it's time to upgrade the RAM or buy a new laptop.

Data_Engineer.title: Data Engineer / Big Data Architect
Data_Engineer.primary_match_text: You are the ultimate builder! You love taking messy, chaotic situations and organizing them into smooth, efficient systems.
Data_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Building massive data pipelines, cleaning up raw data, and creating the digital infrastructure that makes AI possible.
Data_Engineer.alternative_match_text: Because of your highly organized and structural mindset, you would also excel in Cloud Computing or Software Development.
Data_Engineer.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in CSE or a B.Sc in Data Science.

ML_Data_Scientist.title: Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist
ML_Data_Scientist.primary_match_text: You are the predictor! You have a sharp, logical brain that loves finding hidden patterns, reading between the lines, and forecasting the future.
ML_Data_Scientist.day_in_the_life: Training AI models, writing algorithms that predict human behavior, and solving complex real-world problems with math.
ML_Data_Scientist.alternative_match_text: Your ability to predict outcomes and analyze risks makes you a perfect fit for Financial Modeling or Investment Banking.
ML_Data_Scientist.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in AI & Data Science or Statistics.

Data_Visualization_Analyst.title: Data Visualization Analyst
Data_Visualization_Analyst.primary_match_text: You are the visual translator! You love taking boring, complicated numbers and turning them into beautiful, colorful, and easy-to-understand designs.
Data_Visualization_Analyst.day_in_the_life: Creating stunning interactive dashboards, colorful charts, and presentations that help companies understand their data.
Data_Visualization_Analyst.alternative_match_text: If you want a more design-focused career, your aesthetic sense makes you a perfect candidate for UI/UX Design or Graphic Arts.
Data_Visualization_Analyst.roadmap: Any stream works, but Commerce or PCM is preferred. Pursue a degree in BCA, B.Sc IT, or specialized Data Analytics.

AI_Business_Strategist.title: AI Product Manager / Business Strategist
AI_Business_Strategist.primary_match_text: You are the mastermind! You look at data and technology not just for fun, but to make smart decisions, save money, and lead others.
AI_Business_Strategist.day_in_the_life: Looking at AI insights to launch new tech products, managing engineering teams, and increasing the company's profit.
AI_Business_Strategist.alternative_match_text: With your street-smart business approach, you would naturally excel as a Startup Founder, CEO, or Management Consultant.
AI_Business_Strategist.roadmap: Take Commerce or PCM in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA, B.Tech followed by an MBA in Business Analytics.
